description: List the user's own Picorn files (posts and slideshows, newest first) with fileId, title, project, aspect ratio, thumbnail and editorUrl. No workspace key is needed. Any fileId can be scheduled with picorn_posts_schedule; files made in the web editor post the slides Picorn last rendered for them. Files with mcpEditable: true can also be changed with the picorn_editor_* tools. Page with nextCursor. Requires a Picorn access token.
name: picorn_files_list
title: Picorn Library: list the user's files
